chapterFiles.title: Genesis 1 — When Elohim began to shape

versionTitles.ja: ホイール・オブ・ヘブン訳

subtitles.en: First book of the Torah — creation, the flood, and the patriarchs

descriptions.en: An English translation of Genesis 1 from the pointed Hebrew of the Westminster Leningrad Codex (Public Domain), presented in parallel with the source. Per-verse commentary documents the lexical choices that distinguish this rendering from inherited English versions — the plurality of *Elohim*, *bara* and *asah* as distinct creative acts, *raqia* as a hammered-out dome, the cohortative *na'aseh* in verse 26, *tselem* and *demut* as physical resemblance, and the polemical avoidance of *shemesh* and *yareach* in verses 14–16. This is the first chapter published under the Wheel of Heaven Translation Program; the draft was prepared with Claude Opus 4.7 against translation-glossary v1.0.0 and awaits human review.
